# LLM-Policy for Edu Carnival
# This file provides guidance for AI and LLM crawlers.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Purpose: Edu Carnival is an Education Expo platform helping students find universities and courses.
# Key Pages:
# - /education-expo: Main landing page for the 2026 expo.
# - /events/upcoming: Schedule of upcoming education fairs.
# - /registration/participant: Registration for students.
